Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Trichy Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow position, candidates must have a B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech with First Class in ECE, EEE, or Instrumentation and Control Engineering from a UGC recognized University/College, along with a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate - I position is 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST candidates (5 years) and OBC candidates (3 years).

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate - I posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview round.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs. 37,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their applications in softcopy PDF form to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate - I in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Which departments are eligible for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with qualifications in ECE, EEE, and Instrumentation and Control Engineering are eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.
